The bee hive is used to raise [[bee]]s and can be harvested once a day.  It takes only {{Energy||10}} to harvest, half the energy that it would take to harvest from a wild hive. Bee hives can only be built in the [[apiary]].

'''Note that the amount of [[bee]]s you'll need to build the hive varies from 10 to 20 depending on your version of the game. 10 is for PC and Console, 20 for Mobile<sup>[1]</sup>.'''

From the 4 broken hives (3 at the Apiary, 1 behind the Beekeeper), you can recover up to {{Item|Flitch|1}} and {{Item|Metal scrap|3}} per hive.
